ask_mic_tap.sl: 🎤 Tapnite Govori in govorite — ali pišite spodaj
ask_mic_tap.en: 🎤 Tap Speak, then talk — or type below

ask_err_perm.sl: Dovoljenje za mikrofon je izklopljeno — tapnite 🔒 v naslovni vrstici → dovoli mikrofon
ask_err_perm.en: Mic permission is off — tap 🔒 in the address bar → allow microphone

ask_err_mic.sl: Mikrofona ni mogoče uporabiti — napišite vprašanje
ask_err_mic.en: Can't use the microphone — please type instead

ask_err_nospeech.sl: Glasu ni bilo slišati — tapnite Govori znova
ask_err_nospeech.en: No voice heard — tap Speak again

ask_err_other.sl: Glasovni vnos ni uspel ({code}) — napišite vprašanje
ask_err_other.en: Voice input failed ({code}) — please type instead

cf_privacy.sl: Vaše ime in čas potrditve bosta poslana delodajalcu kot evidenca usposabljanja.
cf_privacy.en: Your name and confirmation time will be sent to the workplace as a training record.
